widgets_values: In a softly lit, modern living room, a surreal event unfolds as a single orange and white clownfish swims gracefully through the air, continuously circling the head of a young man. The man, in his early twenties with dark, curly hair, sits calmly at a wooden desk, wearing a comfortable cream-colored knit sweater. His expression is one of quiet awe, his eyes subtly tracking the fish's rhythmic, looping path around him. The clownfish moves as if through water, its fins gently propelling it forward in a steady, circular motion. Its scales glisten with a wet sheen under the warm, diffused light coming from a large window to the left, and a few stray, glistening water droplets seem to trail in its wake, hanging in the air for a moment before vanishing. In the background, intentionally out of focus, sits a rectangular glass fish tank filled with clear blue water and swaying green aquatic plants, the source of this airborne marvel. The camera remains static in a medium shot, maintaining an eye-level perspective with the seated man. This fixed viewpoint captures both the man's serene reaction and the fish's complete, unending orbit around his head, emphasizing the dreamlike and continuous nature of the scene. Cinematic photography realistic style.

nodes.title: MovieRoll Text Encode
Note: Text to Long Video (MovieRoll)
widgets_values:
## Text to Long Video (MovieRoll)

One continuous shot of 10 to 60 seconds from a text prompt, 864x480 at 24 fps. MovieRoll is Tencent's HunyuanVideo 1.5 distilled to roll a video out in chunks: five chunks at once, each at its own noise level, and the finished chunks go to a cache the later ones read. People, places and light stay the same over the whole length.

**Load MovieRoll** → **MovieRoll Text Encode** → **MovieRoll Sampler** (5 steps per chunk, no CFG) → **VAE Decode** → **Save Video** (`output/video/movieroll_...`).

**Licence to accept first.** Accept the Tencent Hunyuan Community Licence on [yunyangge/MovieRoll](https://huggingface.co/yunyangge/MovieRoll) with the account whose token is `HF_TOKEN` in `.env`; approval is instant. The licence does not apply in the European Union, the United Kingdom and South Korea: there you have no right to use these weights.

## Settings worth knowing

- **MovieRoll Sampler, length**: 721 frames, 30 seconds. 17 + a multiple of 16; 1441 is 60 seconds. Time grows with length; the cache does not, as it is rebuilt from five chunks once it holds 18. 30 s took 13 to 15 minutes here; 60 s about twice that, with about the same memory.
- **MovieRoll Sampler, width and height**: 864x480, what MovieRoll was trained at.
- **MovieRoll Sampler, seed**: the sampler follows Tencent's own; over long videos small rounding differences change the motion, not the scene.
- **MovieRoll Text Encode**: MovieRoll's own prompt template. Text in "double quotes" is also read letter by letter, for writing that appears in the video.
- **Load LoRA (optional)**: bypassed. A HunyuanVideo 1.5 LoRA loads here.

## Full quality: H3 refine

The group below the draft is off. Make a draft first; when it is worth keeping, set the group to Always and queue again with the same seed and prompt: ComfyUI reuses the draft it already made (after a restart the same seed makes it again), and MiniMax H3 redraws it at 2x (1728x960) in 10 s segments with latent-guided continuity, using the same **Prompt**. Measured on a 30 s draft: about 40 minutes more, 15 GiB lowest available memory (the group first unloads the draft's models), sharper eyes, skin and hair with the person, pose and motion kept; small objects can change shape a little. The cuts are seconds into the video, one every 10 s: `10,20` for 30 s, `10,20,30,40,50` for 60 s; a cut past the end stops the run. The H3 weights are under the MiniMax H3 community licence.

## Model Links

**diffusion_models**

- [movieroll_distilled_t2v_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/yunyangge/MovieRoll/resolve/fe3150d9233e54c504c04b4b42e12ebbc76b7765/distilled/t2v/model.safetensors) (33.3 GB, `distilled/t2v/model.safetensors` renamed; loaded in bf16)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/HunyuanVideo_1.5_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) (9.4 GB)
- [byt5_small_glyphxl_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/HunyuanVideo_1.5_repackaged/resolve/1405a2b738c29b890cf6d03fc038d8d3e92eeed7/split_files/text_encoders/byt5_small_glyphxl_fp16.safetensors) (0.44 GB)

**vae**

- [hunyuanvideo15_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/HunyuanVideo_1.5_repackaged/resolve/1405a2b738c29b890cf6d03fc038d8d3e92eeed7/split_files/vae/hunyuanvideo15_vae_fp16.safetensors) (2.5 GB)

## Where this workflow comes from

Our own graph. The MovieRoll nodes (this pack's `movieroll_nodes.py`) run MovieRoll's distilled sampler on ComfyUI core's HunyuanVideo 1.5 model; they follow Tencent's MovieRoll code (Tencent Hunyuan Community Licence, copy and notice in the pack's `licenses/`). The prompt is the clownfish example from MovieRoll's README.

minimax_h3_prompt_reference_doc.text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the little sister from <Picture 1>, a chibi girl with long wavy blue-gradient hair, a single bouncy ahoge, a white lace maid headdress, blue bow hair ornaments with small white wings, large round blue eyes, a navy lolita maid dress with a white apron printed with a blue whale, gold hem trim, white socks, navy shoes, and a small blue fin-shaped tail.
<Subject 2> is the older sister from <Picture 2>, a young woman with long dark hair fading into purple-magenta streaks, white feather hair ornaments, and an elegant white-and-purple sheer fantasy gown with gold accents and flowing translucent fabric.
<Subject 3> is the moonlit lakeside environment shown with <Subject 2> in <Picture 2>, featuring a huge full moon, a calm lake with drifting mist, and a mossy rock bank dotted with small white flowers.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1), binding the little sister's spoken lines to its vocal character.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] The target video shows <Subject 1>, the little sister, running to visit <Subject 2>, the older sister, at <Subject 3>, the moonlit lakeside. The little sister calls out, clings to her sister's arm, and acts coquettish until the older sister warmly agrees to spend the day with her. <Audio 1> serves as the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1) across all her lines.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the chibi build, blue-gradient hair, ahoge, lace headdress, whale-print apron dress, and fin tail are retained throughout.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the dark-to-purple hair, white feather ornaments, and white-and-purple sheer gown are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the full moon, misty lake, and mossy rock bank remain the constant setting.
<Audio 1>: reference - the little sister's dialogue delivery follows <Audio 1>'s sweet young voice timbre without copying the original signal.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a soft fantasy anime style with luminous blue moonlight, a gentle glow, and a warm sisterly mood.
[Shot 1] A wide establishing shot shows <Subject 3>, the moonlit lakeside: an enormous full moon dominates the night sky above a calm lake, thin mist drifts over the water, and a mossy rock covered with small white flowers rises from a grassy bank in the foreground. <Subject 2>, the older sister with long dark hair fading into purple-magenta streaks, white feather hair ornaments, and a flowing white-and-purple sheer gown trimmed with gold, sits gracefully on the mossy rock, her translucent train spread over the stone as she gazes toward the water. From the left, <Subject 1>, the little sister with her blue-gradient hair, springy ahoge, lace headdress, whale-print apron dress, and little fin tail, runs into frame with quick, light steps, hair and apron fluttering. She stops in front of <Subject 2> and calls up at her in the bright, sweet young voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 姐姐～我来找你玩啦！</d> The camera pushes in slowly as <Subject 2> turns her head, her expression softening into a smile.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a medium two-shot beside the rock. <Subject 1> (S1) clings to <Subject 2>'s arm, hugging it with both small hands, swaying side to side and tilting her head so the ahoge bounces, looking up with wide, sparkling, pleading eyes in an unmistakably coquettish gesture. Keeping the same sweet voice timbre bound to <Audio 1>, she draws out her words playfully, <d>[Chinese] 陪人家玩嘛，好不好嘛？</d> She tugs the sleeve gently and puffs her cheeks in a tiny pout while moonlight rims both figures in silver.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2> (S2), the older sister from Shot 1, smiling down warmly. She answers in a gentle, mature female voice, <d>[Chinese] 好呀，今天就一直陪着你。</d> She reaches out and pats <Subject 1>'s head between the lace headdress ribbons; the little sister beams, cheers softly, and nuzzles against her arm as the lake shimmers under the full moon behind them.

overall_soundscape:
Gentle night-lakeside ambience continues throughout: soft water lapping, a light breeze through the grass, faint insect chirps, and the subtle rustle of fabric as the sisters move.

non_diegetic_music:
A delicate music-box and harp score at a slow, lullaby-like tempo, with soft celesta accents that warm slightly when the older sister agrees to stay with her little sister.
